human_review.description: Run these shared checks first. If none matches, continue to the selected operation.

invalid_risk_flags.given: A supplied disputed, unsafe_item or human_requested flag is not a boolean.

outcome.reason: Risk flags must be verified booleans.

disputed_facts.given: The facts or findings are disputed.

outcome.reason: Conflicting facts require human review.

unsafe_goods.given: The goods are unsafe to handle or demonstrate.

outcome.reason: Unsafe goods require human review and specific handling instructions.
The customer requested human review.

evidence_unavailable.given: Evidence is unavailable, inaccessible or unsafe to obtain.

outcome.reason: Review the evidence limitation; do not automatically reject the request.

counterfeit_claim.given: The return reason concerns counterfeit goods.

outcome.reason: An authenticity claim requires human assessment.

unsupported_item_type.given: The item is digital, a service or a standalone promotional gift.

outcome.reason: This item is outside the standard physical-return process and needs human review.

refund.description: Check the approval limit, recorded payment, approved amount and remaining balance.

currency_mismatch.given: The recorded payment currency differs from the configured policy currency.

outcome.reason: The payment currency is outside the configured policy; review it before applying the refund limit.

limit_exceeded.given: The requested refund exceeds max_auto_amount in the configured currency.

outcome.reason: The refund exceeds the automatic approval limit and requires human review.

missing_facts.given: Any required payment or approval fact is missing.

outcome.reason: Recorded payment and approval facts are required before refund processing.
The payment has not been established as captured; review the payment before refunding.

different_payment_method.given: Refund to the original payment method is not confirmed.

outcome.reason: Do not redirect the refund to a different payment method.

request_not_accepted.given: Acceptance of the request is not confirmed.

outcome.reason: The request must be accepted before refund payment.

inspection_incomplete.given: Required receipt/inspection or an approved waiver is not confirmed.

outcome.reason: Complete the required inspection or establish an approved waiver before payment.

balance_exceeded.given: The refund exceeds captured amount minus completed and pending refunds.

outcome.reason: The refund exceeds the remaining captured balance; review possible duplicate or excess payment.

approved_amount_exceeded.given: The refund exceeds the recorded approved_refund_amount.

outcome.reason: The requested amount exceeds the approved resolution and needs review.
Refund hard checks passed; this result does not issue payment.

return_request.description: Check the affected item's dates, return reason, evidence and change-of-mind conditions.

missing_dates.given: The affected item's delivered_at or requested_at date is missing.

outcome.reason: The affected item's delivery and request dates are required.

request_before_delivery.given: The recorded request date is earlier than the recorded delivery date.

outcome.reason: The request and delivery dates conflict and need review.

window_exceeded.given: The request falls after the configured inclusive return deadline.

outcome.reason: The request is outside the ordinary return window; human review must consider any exception.

unsupported_reason.given: The reason is not in allowed_reasons and no shared review check already matched.

outcome.reason: The return reason needs human assessment.

unverified_evidence.given: Relevant evidence has not been verified.

outcome.reason: Relevant evidence needs verification before ordinary return checks can pass.

missing_item_conditions.given: For change_of_mind, final_sale or any change_of_mind_required condition is missing or not a boolean.

outcome.reason: The change-of-mind item conditions are incomplete or unverified.

final_sale.given: The verified reason is change_of_mind and the item was final sale at purchase.

outcome.reason: Verified final-sale goods do not qualify for an ordinary change-of-mind return.

item_conditions_failed.given: For a verified change-of-mind return, unused, packaging, tags or accessories conditions fail.

outcome.reason: Verified change-of-mind conditions are not satisfied; the ordinary return request cannot proceed.

passed.given: The request is within its window and all checks for its recorded reason pass.

outcome.reason: Ordinary return-request checks passed; refund payment checks remain separate.

return_dispatch.description: Check authorization, actual carrier handover and any recorded deadline extension.

missing_dates.given: The approval date or actual carrier handover date is missing.

outcome.reason: Return approval and actual handover dates are required.

unapproved_extension.given: An extension date is supplied without recorded human approval.

outcome.reason: The dispatch extension needs recorded human approval.

handover_unverified.given: Actual carrier acceptance is not confirmed; a label alone is insufficient.

outcome.reason: Carrier handover must be established; a label alone does not prove dispatch.

dispatch_before_approval.given: Handover is recorded before return approval.

outcome.reason: Handover predates return approval; review authorization and dates.

deadline_exceeded.given: Handover is after the ordinary deadline or the recorded human-approved replacement deadline.

outcome.reason: Dispatch is outside its authorized deadline; review it rather than automatically cancelling the return.

passed.given: Authorized handover is confirmed within the applicable inclusive deadline.

outcome.reason: Return dispatch was within the authorized deadline.

cancel.description: Check the order is processing and every fulfillment blocker is confirmed absent.

outcome.reason: The order is already cancelled; do not cancel it again.

wrong_order_status.given: The order status is missing or differs from allowed_order_status.

outcome.reason: Ordinary cancellation requires an unfulfilled processing order.

unverified_fulfillment.given: Any configured fulfillment blocker is missing or not a verified boolean.

outcome.reason: The fulfillment status is incomplete or unverified.

fulfillment_started.given: A label exists, packing began, any quantity was fulfilled or the carrier collected the parcel.

outcome.reason: Fulfillment has begun; cancellation or amendment requires human review.

passed.given: The order is processing and all fulfillment blockers are confirmed false.

outcome.reason: Ordinary cancellation checks passed; confirmation and the actual update are still required.

delivery.description: Check immediate investigation cases before counting days beyond the estimated delivery date.

immediate_investigation.given: The recorded status is in immediate_human_statuses.

outcome.reason: The recorded delivery issue requires immediate human investigation.

delivered.given: Delivery is recorded and no dispute or shared human-review trigger was supplied.

outcome.reason: Recorded delivery; denied receipt must be flagged for investigation. This is not refund approval.

unknown_status.given: The shipment status is missing or unrecognized.

outcome.reason: The recorded shipment status must be established.

missing_dates.given: An ordinary undelivered shipment lacks estimated_delivery or as_of.

outcome.reason: The estimated delivery and assessment dates are required.

waiting_period_exceeded.given: An undelivered shipment is more than investigate_after_calendar_days after its estimate.

outcome.reason: The shipment is beyond the ordinary waiting period and requires human investigation.

passed.given: The shipment is before its estimate or no more than the configured number of days late.

outcome.reason: Ordinary tracking follow-up can continue; this is not refund approval.
